title: Dominic and the Extraction
author: Lena Crane
blurb: Ada Hartwell, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
